children: The White House midterm election watch party will be fueled by at least one big order from the Cheesecake Factory, according to a post on X from Kaelan Dorr, the White House's head of digital strategy.
"WH eating good on a big day," Dorr posted, along with a photo of a Cheesecake Factory takeout bag. A White House official confirmed that the order is, indeed, for the White House gathering.

The takeout order is a callback to a recent comment from former President Barack Obama on the campaign trail, when he said that President Trump's golden flourishes and additions to the White House make the place look like "Saddam Hussein opened a Cheesecake Factory."

Trump and conservatives took umbrage at Obama's comments, saying that he was being elitist and deriding an eatery that many Americans love. Obama later expressed surprise that there wasn't much pushback on the first part of his joke, in which he compared Trump's tastes to those of a deposed Iraqi dictator.
